1.title: Indian Society: Firsts and Welfare Institutions

mcqs.question: Who was the first woman teacher in India?
mcqs.explanation: Savitribai Phule is identified as the first woman teacher in India.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: The first Census in India was conducted in 1872.
The first Census to record caste comprehensively was conducted in 1931.
The first complete Census in India was conducted in 1872.
The first complete Census in India was conducted in 1881.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is the year of the first complete Census. It was conducted in 1881, whereas 1872 was the year of the first Census in India.

mcqs.question:

options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: Brahmo Samaj was the first major socio-religious reform movement, and Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the first reform movement. The reason does not explain why Brahmo Samaj is classified as the first movement.
